calls.statement:
SELECT SUM(fsl.quantity) AS total_units
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
WHERE ds.store_id = 108
  AND LOWER(dp.subcategory) = 'interior paint'
  AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-06-29' 
  AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-08-02'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS line_count, SUM(quantity) AS total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipt_count
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
WHERE ds.store_id = 108
  AND LOWER(dp.subcategory) = 'interior paint'
  AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-06-29' 
  AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-08-02'
